subject: general
question: Which natural disaster triggered storms, flash floods, and landslips in the northeastern states of India in 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cyclone Remal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Cyclone Remal** was a significant weather event that caused extensive damage in the northeastern states of India in 2024.
 
• The cyclone brought about severe **storms, flash floods, and landslips** in the region, leading to widespread disruption.
 
• It was among the most destructive cyclones to hit the northeastern part of India in recent history, impacting thousands of lives and properties.
 
• Emergency response teams were deployed to assist in rescue and relief operations, highlighting the importance of disaster preparedness and management.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cyclones:**

 
 
• A cyclone is a large scale air mass that rotates around a strong center of low atmospheric pressure.
 
• Cyclones are characterized by inward spiraling winds that rotate counterclockwise in the Northern Hemisphere and clockwise in the Southern Hemisphere.
 
• They are classified into different types such as tropical cyclones, extratropical cyclones, and subtropical cyclones based on their formation and characteristics.
 
 
 
• **Flash Floods:**
 
 
• Flash floods are rapid flooding of low-lying areas: washes, rivers, dry lakes, and basins.
 
• They are caused by heavy rain associated with a severe thunderstorm, hurricane, or cyclone.
 
• Flash floods can occur within minutes or hours of heavy rainfall, and can also occur when dams or levees break.
 
 
 
• **Landslips:**
 
 
• Landslips, also known as landslides, involve the movement of rock, earth, or debris down a sloped section of land.
 
• They are often caused by rainfall, earthquakes, volcanic activity, or other factors that make the slope unstable.
 
• Landslips can cause significant damage to infrastructure, property, and can also result in loss of life.
